intentMapping.decision: Do not create Cloud feature/metadata claims for templates, automatic rota generation, shift alarms, pay or overtime.

intentMapping.detail: Week guide already covers exact endpoints, all-day distinctions, travel/recovery blocks and selected calendars; lacks a worked overnight shift spanning adjacent days.

intentMapping.task: Distinguish a shift from an all-day work label
intentMapping.detail: Timed versus date-based commitment and independent availability are already substantive.

intentMapping.task: Verify schedules near seasonal clock changes
intentMapping.detail: Event/display zones and recurring seasonal transitions covered; avoid promising every 22:00–06:00 shift is eight elapsed hours.

oneUsefulChange.placement: Short worked example after exact start/end checks or in preparation/recovery section.
oneUsefulChange.proposal: For a shift starting Monday at 22:00 and ending Tuesday at 06:00, record both dates and inspect Monday evening and Tuesday morning. A label placed only on Monday does not communicate the Tuesday finish. Before offering a Tuesday morning appointment, include the actual journey and any personal recovery time you need; use the employer's confirmed rota for the shift itself. Follow existing recurrence guidance for a one-off swap rather than assuming an entire rotating pattern should change.
bounds: Do not name a Cloud overnight editor workflow until native source confirms relevant controls and saved date handling.
Do not promise automatic rota generation, payroll, overtime totals, shift templates or wake-up alarms.
Do not label the shift universally eight hours: seasonal zone changes can affect elapsed duration.
Do not imply a personal calendar edit approves an employer shift swap or changes a colleague's rota.

decision.rationale: Current coverage handles general calendar mechanics. One concrete two-date example is a useful extension, whereas a new broad shift-calendar article would either duplicate those mechanics or imply unverified specialist features.

limits: No native inspection/runtime certification, customer actions, source edits, builds, dist changes, deployment, paid APIs or ASC operations.
No search volume, Google rank, ChatGPT citation, exhaustive market coverage or new media claims.
Initial lexical inventory and public queries were batched before complete candidate reads; all four relevant guides were then fully read before primary-body assessment and recommendation.
